description: reddit: Subreddit Search. GET /v1/reddit/subreddit/search. Search within a subreddit for posts, comments, or media matching a query Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

query.description: Search query to find matching content

sort.description: Sort order. For posts/media: relevance, hot, top, new, comments. For comments: relevance, top, new

subreddit.description: Subreddit name (e.g. 'Fitness', not 'r/Fitness' or a full URL)
